pageWall: Shiga don ganin wannan shafi a cikin <name>{{workspace}}</name>
providerNotReady: Wannan mai bayar da shiga ta kafofin zamantakewa bai shirya ba
signupRestricted: An rufe yin rajista a wannan sabar bisa ga ka'idar mai gudanarwa. Don samun gayyata, tambayi wani mai gudanarwa ko wanda ya gaya maka game da wannan sabar.
signupClosedWhoMay: An rufe yin rajista a wannan sabar: adireshin da aka gayyata ko adireshin kamfani da aka yarda da shi ne kawai zai iya ƙirƙirar asusu. Don samun gayyata, tambayi mai gudanarwa.
signupRestrictedNoMail: An rufe yin rajista a wannan sabar bisa ga ka'idar mai gudanarwarta. Idan an gayyace ka, tambayi wanda ya gayyace ka ya ba ka hanyar gayyata, ka buɗe ta.
signupClosedWhoMayNoMail: Hanyar gayyata ce kawai ke ba ka damar shiga wannan sabar. Tambayi wanda ya gayyace ka ya ba ka hanyar, ka buɗe ta.
signupInvitationInvalid: Wannan gayyata ba za ta iya ƙirƙirar asusu ba: wataƙila na wani adireshin imel ne, an riga an yi amfani da ita, an janye ta, ko ta wuce kwanaki 7. Nemi sabuwa.
guestLinkUsed: Wannan hanyar gayyatar baƙon na mutum ɗaya ce kuma an riga an yi amfani da ita. Ka nemi sabuwar hanyar gayyata daga wanda ya aiko ta.
guestLinkExpired: Wannan hanyar gayyatar baƙon ta ƙare. Ka nemi sabuwar hanyar gayyata daga wanda ya aiko ta.
guestLinkOff: An kashe wannan hanyar gayyatar baƙon. Ka nemi sabuwar hanyar gayyata daga wanda ya aiko ta.
guestLinkUnknown: Ba a iya samun wannan hanyar gayyatar baƙon ba. Ka tabbatar an kwafi dukan hanyar gayyatar, ko ka nemi sabuwar hanyar gayyata daga wanda ya aiko ta.
guestLinkNoPages: Wannan hanyar gayyatar baƙon ba ta da sauran shafin da za a raba. Ka gaya wa wanda ya aiko ta.

guestLinkPageHeld.moving: Ana motsa tubalan shafin da wannan hanyar gayyatar baƙon ke rabawa, don haka ba za ka iya shiga yanzu ba. Ba a yi amfani da hanyar ba: ka sake buɗe ta idan an gama.
guestLinkPageHeld.copying: Ana kwafa shafin da wannan hanyar gayyatar baƙon ke rabawa, don haka ba za ka iya shiga yanzu ba. Ba a yi amfani da hanyar ba: ka sake buɗe ta idan an gama kwafin.
guestLinkPageHeld.wiki: Ana canza shafin da wannan hanyar gayyatar baƙon ke rabawa zuwa wiki ko daga wiki, don haka ba za ka iya shiga yanzu ba. Ba a yi amfani da hanyar ba: ka sake buɗe ta idan an gama.
guestLinkPageHeld.other: Shafin da wannan hanyar gayyatar baƙon ke rabawa yana cikin wani canji, don haka ba za ka iya shiga yanzu ba. Ba a yi amfani da hanyar ba: ka sake buɗe ta idan an gama.

nameInvitationUsed: An riga an yi amfani da wannan gayyata. Ka nemi sabuwar gayyata daga wanda ya gayyace ka.
nameInvitationWithdrawn: An janye wannan gayyata. Ka nemi sabuwar gayyata daga wanda ya gayyace ka.
nameInvitationExpired: Wannan gayyata ta wuce kwanaki 7. Ka nemi sabuwar gayyata daga wanda ya gayyace ka.
nameInvitationUnknown: Ba a iya samun wannan gayyata ba. Ka tabbatar an kwafi dukan hanyar gayyatar, ko ka nemi sabuwar gayyata daga wanda ya gayyace ka.
inviteLinkOff: An kashe wannan hanyar gayyata. Ka nemi sabuwar hanyar gayyata daga wanda ya aiko ta.
inviteLinkUnknown: Ba a iya samun wannan hanyar gayyata ba. Wataƙila an maye gurbinta da sabuwa: ka nemi hanyar da ake amfani da ita yanzu daga wanda ya aiko ta.
invitationWorkspaceDeleted: An share wurin aikin wannan gayyata.
invitationMemberAddsStopped: Wannan uwar garken ba ta barin wuraren aiki su ƙara mambobi a yanzu, don haka ba za a iya amfani da wannan gayyata ba. Ka tuntuɓi mai kula da uwar garken.
sessionEnded: Shigarka ta ƙare ko an kawo ƙarshen ta. Sake shiga don komawa inda kake.
passwordWait_one: Kalmomin sirri da ba daidai ba sun yi yawa. Sake gwadawa cikin minti {{count}}, ko shiga da lambar shiga daga na'urar da aka shiga.
passwordWait_other: Kalmomin sirri da ba daidai ba sun yi yawa. Sake gwadawa cikin mintuna {{count}}, ko shiga da lambar shiga daga na'urar da aka shiga.
passwordWaitReason: Kalmomin sirri da ba daidai ba sun yi yawa, don haka an dakatar da shiga da kalmar sirri na ɗan lokaci.
invitationJoinLimited: An ƙirƙiri asusu da yawa daga nan ta hanyar gayyata.
setupCodeLimited: An gwada lambobin saiti da yawa daga nan.
sessionCapacityTitle: Wannan asusu ya kai iyakar zamansa
sessionCapacityBody: Leafen zai iya fitar da zaman da ba a yi amfani da shi ba da daɗewa kawai ya ci gaba. Sauran zaman da kake da su za su ci gaba da shiga.
replaceOldestSession: Fitar da zaman da ba a yi amfani da shi ba da daɗewa ka ci gaba
keepCurrentSessions: Kada ka shiga a wannan na'urar
linkMissingToken: Shiga bai kammala ba. Sake shiga.
actionMissingToken: An yanke hanyar haɗin. Sake buɗe cikakkiyar hanyar haɗin da aka aiko maka.
passwordTooShort: Kalmar sirri ba ta cika ƙa'idar da ke sama ba
enterVerificationCode: Shigar da lambar tabbatarwa mai lambobi shida
totpHint: Yi amfani da lambar mai lambobi shida daga manhajar tabbatarwa
recoveryHint: Yi amfani da ɗaya daga cikin lambobin maidowa da aka adana
useAuthenticatorCode: Yi amfani da manhajar tabbatarwa maimakon
name: Suna
passwordRequirements: Aƙalla alamomi 15, ko aƙalla 8 waɗanda ke gauraya haruffa da lambobi.
forgotPasswordBody: Ku shigar da imel ɗin asusunku. Idan asusun ya wanzu, Leafen zai aika muku hanyar sake saiti ta amfani ɗaya.
forgotPasswordNoMail: Wannan uwar garken ba ya aika imel, don haka ba zai iya aika muku hanyar sake saiti ba. Ku nemi mai kula da wannan uwar garken ya sake saita kalmar sirrinku.
passwordResetSent: Idan akwai asusun wannan imel ɗin, an aika hanyar sake saiti.
passwordResetComplete: An sake saita kalmar sirrinka, kuma an fitar da kowace na'ura. Shiga da sabuwar kalmar sirri.
signupConfirmationSent: Mun aika imel ɗin tabbatarwa zuwa {{email}}. Ku buɗe hanyar haɗin da ke cikinsa don kammala yin rajista.
authActionFailedTitle: Ba a iya buɗe wannan hanyar haɗin ba
addAccountBody: Ku shiga da wani asusu a wannan uwar garken. Asusun da kuke da su ba za su fita ba.
setupBody: Zaɓi sunanku kuma kun shiga. Ku ne na farko a nan, don haka ku ke kula da wannan Leafen.
setupBackupsOff: Kwafin ajiya da aka tsara a kashe su a yanzu: da zarar kun shiga, ku kunna su a Saituna → Uwar garken → Ajiya.
mustChangeBody: Wani mai gudanarwa ya ce ka canza kalmar sirrinka. Shigar da kalmar sirrinka ta yanzu (ko ta wucin gadi da aka ba ka) da sabuwa.
mustChangeBodyHanded: Wani mai gudanarwa ya ce ka canza kalmar sirrinka. Zaɓi sabuwa.
confirmPassword: Tabbatar da sabuwar kalmar sirrin ku
changePasswordCta: Canza kalmar sirri sannan ku ci gaba

notionConsent.title: Haɗa {{client}}
notionConsent.intro: <client>{{client}}</client> zai iya karanta, gyara da yin tsokaci a kan shafukan da kuka zaɓa da shafukan da ke ƙarƙashinsu. Kuna iya cire haɗinsa a Saituna → Haɗi.
notionConsent.pages: Shafukan da za a ba da izinin shiga
notionConsent.noPages: Babu shafukan da za a zaɓa.
notionConsent.noneChosen: Idan ba ku zaɓi wani shafi ba, wannan manhaja ba za ta iya ganin kowane shafi ba.
notionConsent.chosen_one: Yana ba da izinin shiga shafi {{count}} da shafukan da ke ƙarƙashinsa.
notionConsent.chosen_other: Yana ba da izinin shiga shafuka {{count}} da shafukan da ke ƙarƙashinsu.
notionConsent.loadFailed: Ba a iya karanta buƙatar haɗin ba. Sake farawa daga manhajar da kuke haɗawa.
notionConsent.notAllowed: Ba za a iya haɗa manhajoji da wannan wurin aiki ko shafukan da aka zaɓa ba.
notionConsent.approveFailed: Ba a iya ba da izinin haɗin ba. Sake gwadawa.

mcpConsent.loadFailed: Ba a iya loda buƙatar haɗin ba. Sake haɗawa daga MCP client ɗinku.
mcpConsent.moreWorkspacesFailed: Ba a iya loda ƙarin wuraren aiki ba. Sake gwadawa.
mcpConsent.approveFailed: Ba a iya amincewa da haɗin ba. Duba wuraren aikin da aka zaɓa sannan sake gwadawa.
mcpConsent.denyFailed: Ba a iya aiwatar da ƙin ba. Koma zuwa MCP client ɗinku ku sake gwadawa.
mcpConsent.title: Amince da haɗin MCP
mcpConsent.chooseWorkspaces: Zaɓi wuraren aikin da <client>{{client}}</client> zai iya amfani da su
mcpConsent.agentIntro: <client>{{client}}</client> yana neman haɗa zuwa Leafen a matsayinka
mcpConsent.access: A cikin wuraren aikin da aka zaɓa, zai iya yin duk abin da za ku iya yi, a matsayinku: karantawa, gyara, kuma idan kuna mai gudanarwa, gudanarwa. Wuraren da ba ku zaɓa ba za su kasance a ɓoye.
mcpConsent.agentAccess: Yana aiki a matsayinka, da duk abin da za ka iya yi a Leafen, a duk wuraren aikinka — karatu, gyara, kuma idan kai mai gudanarwa ne, sarrafawa — sunanka kan abin da ya canza. Za ka iya cire haɗin a kowane lokaci a saitunan Leafen.
mcpConsent.connectionsNear: Za ku iya ƙirƙirar ƙarin haɗin wakilai {{left}} (har zuwa {{limit}} ga kowane mutum). Kuna iya cire haɗin waɗanda ba ku ƙara amfani da su ba a Saituna → Fasaloli → Wakilai.
mcpConsent.connectionsFull: Kun isa iyakar haɗin wakilai (har zuwa {{limit}} ga kowane mutum). Cire haɗin ɗaya da ba ku ƙara amfani da shi ba a Saituna → Fasaloli → Wakilai, sannan ku dawo nan don ba da izini.
mcpConsent.waitingFull: Haɗin da aka amince da su da yawa har yanzu suna jiran wakilansu. Sake gwadawa cikin ƴan mintuna.

appAccess.read: Zai iya karanta shafuka, database da sharhi a cikin wuraren aikin da aka zaɓa, a matsayinku.
appAccess.content: Zai iya karantawa da gyara shafuka, blocks, sharhi, fayiloli da layukan database a cikin wuraren aikin da aka zaɓa, a matsayinku.
appAccess.structure: Hakanan zai iya canza database, ra'ayoyi, ayyukan atomatik, gefen gefe da rabawa a cikin wuraren aikin da aka zaɓa, a matsayinku.
appAccess.admin: Hakanan zai iya gudanar da membobi da saitunan wuraren aikin da aka zaɓa, a matsayinku.

mcpConsent.integrationLegend: Shigar da shi a matsayin asusun manhajar kanta
mcpConsent.integrationNote: Manhajar tana aiki a matsayin asusunta a cikin wurin aikin da kuka zaɓa, ba a matsayinku ba, kuma tana ci gaba da aiki idan kun bar. Wuraren aikin da kuka mallaka ne kawai aka jera.
mcpConsent.integrationGuest: Baƙo — yana ganin shafukan da aka raba masa kawai
mcpConsent.integrationMember: Memba — yana ganin abin da membobi ke gani

integrationAccess.read: Asusunsa zai iya karanta shafuka, database da sharhin da aka ba shi a cikin wurin aiki.
integrationAccess.content: Asusunsa zai iya karantawa da gyara shafuka, blocks, sharhi, fayiloli da layukan database da aka ba shi a cikin wurin aiki.
integrationAccess.structure: Asusunsa kuma zai iya canza database, ra'ayoyi, ayyukan atomatik da rabawa na abin da aka ba shi.
integrationAccess.admin: Asusunsa kuma zai iya gudanar da abin da aka ba shi, gwargwadon rawar da yake da ita a wurin aiki.
integrationAccess.mcp: Asusunsa zai iya karantawa, gyara da gudanar da abin da aka ba shi a cikin wurin aiki, gwargwadon rawar da yake da ita.

mcpConsent.remoteAllowed: An ba da izini. Koma zuwa allon wakilin; zai ci gaba daga can.
mcpConsent.appSpacesNote: Wuraren manhajoji: inda manhajoji da aka shigar ke ajiye bayanansu. Zaɓi ɗaya kawai idan wakili ya kamata ya yi amfani da bayanan wannan manhajar.
mcpConsent.stagingSpacesNote: Matakin shigo da bayanai: wuraren wucin gadi da shigo da bayanai ke cikawa kafin shafukansa su koma wurinsu; ana cire su idan an gama.

finishInBrowser: Kammala shiga a burauzarka. Leafen zai ci gaba idan ka gama.

deviceCodeHint: A na'urar da aka shiga, zaɓi sunan wurin aiki a gefen shafin → Ƙara na'ura don samun lamba da QR.

deviceCodeServerAdministrator: Ni ne ke gudanar da wannan uwar garken
deviceCodeNoDeviceHint: Gudanar da wannan a kwamfutar uwar garke don samun lambar sau ɗaya.
agentSignInHelp: Idan an haɗa Leafen da wakilin AI kamar Claude ko Codex
agentSignInBody: Aika jimlar da ke ƙasa ga Claude ko Codex da aka haɗa da Leafen, sannan wannan burauza za ta shiga.
agentSignInBodyApp: Aika jimlar da ke ƙasa ga Claude ko Codex da aka haɗa da Leafen, sannan wannan manhaja za ta shiga.

agentSignInWaiting_other: Yi amfani da shi sau ɗaya, cikin minti {{count}}.
agentSignInDeclined: An ƙi shiga a cikin wakilin.
deviceFirstHint: Sami lamba a na'urar da aka shiga: gefen shafin → sunan wurin aiki → Ƙara na'ura.
serverLogCodeHint: Idan kai mai gudanarwa ne kuma babu na'urar da ta shiga, sami lamba ta lokaci ɗaya daga kwamfutar uwar garke.
serverLogCodeFind: Nemo lambar sau ɗaya a cikin rikodin uwar garke:
serverLogCodeStatus: Ko kuma gudanar da <command>leafen setup status</command> a kwamfutar uwar garke.
serverLogCodeEnter: Shigar da ita a ƙarƙashin “Shiga da lamba”, a sama, cikin minti goma.
companyHint: Shigar da imel ɗin aikinka, sai shigan kamfaninka ya buɗe.
companyNotFound: Babu shigan kamfani don wannan adireshin a wannan uwar garke.
scanHint: Sanya lambar QR ta ɗayan na'urar a cikin murabba'in.
scanDenied: Ba a ba da izinin kamara ba. Ku rubuta lambar a maimakon haka.
scanNeedsHttps: Kamara tana buɗewa ne kawai a adireshin https. Ku rubuta lambar a maimakon haka.
scanUnavailable: Ba za a iya amfani da kamara a nan ba. Ku rubuta lambar a maimakon haka.
scanNoCode: Wannan lambar QR ba ta da lambar shiga. Ku duba lambar QR daga Ƙara na'ura ta ɗayan na'urar, ko ku rubuta lambar.
setupNameNote: Wasu suna ganin ku da wannan suna. Kuna iya canza shi kowane lokaci.

invitationBodyAsks: Ku zaɓi suna, sannan ku nemi shiga wannan wurin aiki.

invitationHaveAccount: Na riga na buɗe asusu a nan
invitationSignIn: Imel ɗin wannan gayyata yana da asusu a nan. Shiga, kuma gayyatar naka ce.
deviceOwnerButton: Shiga a matsayin mai wannan na'ura
deviceOwnerHelp: Touch ID, Face ID ko kalmar sirrin na'urar suna tabbatar da cewa kai ne mai wannan na'urar.
deviceOwnerHelpWindows: Windows Hello ko kalmar sirrin Windows suna tabbatar da cewa kai ne mai wannan na'urar.
deviceOwnerReason: Sake shiga Leafen a wannan na'urar
deviceOwnerUnavailable: Wannan na'urar ba ta iya tabbatar da mai ita ba. Shiga da lamba daga wata na'ura ko wadda mai gudanarwa ya ƙirƙira.
deviceOwnerNoAccounts: Leafen na wannan na'urar ba shi da asusun da za a shiga.
deviceOwnerRefused: Wannan asusu ba zai iya shiga ta wannan hanyar ba.
setupCodeHelp: Buɗe hanyar haɗin saitin da uwar garken ya buga yana cika lambar.
setupCodeEnvHint: LEAFEN_SETUP_CODE da aka fara uwar garken da shi ma yana aiki.
setupOutsideTitle: Ba a saita Leafen ba tukuna
setupOutsideBody: Domin aminci, ana yin saitin farko ne daga hanyar sadarwa ɗaya da wannan uwar garke. Buɗe wannan uwar garke daga kwamfuta ko waya a cikin gida ko ofis ɗaya, kuma suna ne kawai ake buƙata.
setupOutsideHome: A wannan hanyar sadarwa, buɗe shi a
setupOutsideAwayTitle: Idan dole ne a saita shi daga waje
setupOutsideAwayBody: Buɗe hanyar haɗin saiti da ke cikin log ɗin uwar garke. Log ɗin uwar garke yana nan:
setupOutsideSynology: Synology: Container Manager → Container → buɗe kwantena ta Leafen → Log
setupOutsideAgent: Za ka iya kuma tambayar wakilinka: “Nemo mini hanyar haɗin saitin Leafen.”
setupOutsideCodeNote: Idan kana da lambar saiti, saka ta da kanka: LEAFEN_SETUP_CODE da aka fara uwar garke da ita, ko abin da ke bayan #code= a cikin hanyar haɗin saiti.
secondDeviceScan: Duba lambar QR da kyamarar wayarka, sannan Leafen ya buɗe a wayarka, an riga an shiga.
secondDeviceScanApp: Manhajar Leafen ma za ta iya duba ta.
secondDeviceTypeCode: A na'urar da ba ta da kyamara, rubuta lambobin da ke ƙasa a ƙarƙashin “Shiga da lamba” a allon shigarta.
secondDeviceBackup: Madadin shiga (imel da kalmar sirri, ko passkey) kuma ana iya saita shi a ƙasa.
secondDeviceQRAlt: Lambar QR don shiga a wata na'ura
secondDeviceJoinedBody: Fita a wannan na'urar ba ya fitar da ɗayan. Don fitar da ita, zaɓi “Fita” kusa da ita a Saituna → Asusu → Na'ura.

appSignIn.title: Yi rajistar wannan manhaja a matsayin na'ura?
appSignIn.body: Ana shiga wannan uwar garke da {{app}} a matsayin {{account}}. Yin rijista yana ƙara manhajar cikin na'urorin wannan asusun.
appSignIn.registered: Ana komawa zuwa manhajar. Za ka iya rufe wannan taga.
appSignIn.cancelled: Ba a yi rajistar manhajar ba. Za ka iya rufe wannan taga.
appSignIn.failed: Ba a iya yin rajistar manhajar ba. Sake farawa daga manhajar.
appSignIn.browserHint: Idan burauzar da kuka saba amfani da ita tana shiga wannan uwar garke, danna “Rijista” sau ɗaya zai shigar da ku.

phoneDeviceBody: Sabar tana da adireshin jama'a, don haka wayarku za ta iya buɗe ta kuma.

signedInLink.invitationTitle: Wannan gayyata tana ƙirƙirar sabon asusu
signedInLink.guestLinkNotTaken: {{account}} bai iya karɓar wannan hanyar gayyatar baƙo ba. A sake buɗe ta, kuma idan har yanzu ba ta aiki ba, a gaya wa wanda ya aiko ta.
signedInLink.invitationBodyFor: Wannan gayyata ce ta {{invited}} don ƙirƙirar asusu da shiga. Wannan burauza tana shiga a matsayin {{account}}, don haka ba a yi amfani da ita a nan ba. Buɗe ta a na'urar wanda aka gayyata, ko a wata burauza ko a taga mai zaman kansa.
signedInLink.invitationBodyForApp: Wannan gayyata ce ta {{invited}} don ƙirƙirar asusu da shiga. Wannan manhaja tana shiga a matsayin {{account}}, don haka ba a yi amfani da ita a nan ba. Buɗe ta a na'urar wanda aka gayyata, ko a taga mai zaman kansa na burauza.
signedInLink.invitationBody: Gayyata ce don ƙirƙirar asusu da shiga. Wannan burauza tana shiga a matsayin {{account}}, don haka ba a yi amfani da ita a nan ba. Buɗe ta a na'urar wanda aka gayyata, ko a wata burauza ko a taga mai zaman kansa.
signedInLink.invitationBodyApp: Gayyata ce don ƙirƙirar asusu da shiga. Wannan manhaja tana shiga a matsayin {{account}}, don haka ba a yi amfani da ita a nan ba. Buɗe ta a na'urar wanda aka gayyata, ko a taga mai zaman kansa na burauza.
signedInLink.invitationUnusable: Ba za a iya amfani da wannan gayyata ba: an riga an yi amfani da ita, an soke ta, ko ta ƙare. Wannan burauza tana ci gaba da shiga a matsayin {{account}}.
signedInLink.invitationUnusableApp: Ba za a iya amfani da wannan gayyata ba: an riga an yi amfani da ita, an soke ta, ko ta ƙare. Wannan manhaja tana ci gaba da shiga a matsayin {{account}}.
signedInLink.stillSignedIn: Wannan burauza tana ci gaba da shiga a matsayin {{account}}.
signedInLink.stillSignedInApp: Wannan manhaja tana ci gaba da shiga a matsayin {{account}}.

signedInLink.deviceBody: Link ɗin amfani sau ɗaya ne da ke shigar da na'ura ɗaya cikin asusu. Wannan burauza tuni tana shiga a matsayin {{account}}, don haka ba a yi amfani da shi a nan ba. Buɗe shi a na'urar da ya kamata ta shiga, ko a wata burauza ko a taga mai zaman kansa.
signedInLink.deviceBodyApp: Link ɗin amfani sau ɗaya ne da ke shigar da na'ura ɗaya cikin asusu. Wannan manhaja tuni tana shiga a matsayin {{account}}, don haka ba a yi amfani da shi a nan ba. Buɗe shi a na'urar da ya kamata ta shiga, ko a taga mai zaman kansa na burauza.

setupRestoreOpen: Mayar da shi daga kwafin ajiya
setupRestoreBody: Faɗa wa Leafen inda ajiyar uwar garken da ya ɓace take. Ana cika wannan uwar garke daga replica mai ci gaba ko ajiya da ke wurin, sannan ku shiga da tsohon asusun ku.
setupRestoreFolderDevice: Babban fayil da aka zaɓa a wannan waya
setupRestoreFolderHelp: Cikakkiyar hanyar babban fayil ɗin da ke ɗauke da “Leafen backups”, ko kuma ta wannan babban fayil ɗin kansa.
setupRestoreFolderHelpContainer: Wannan uwar garke tana aiki a cikin kwantena, don haka ba za ta iya karanta hanyar babban fayil na wannan kwamfuta ba. Saka {{folder}}, wurin da aka ɗora don kwafin ajiya, ko hanyar babban fayil ɗin da ke cikinsa mai ɗauke da “Leafen backups”.
setupRestoreFolderHelpDevice: Zaɓi babban fayil ɗin da ke ɗauke da “Leafen backups”, ko kuma wannan babban fayil ɗin kansa.
setupRestoreNoFolderPicked: Ba a zaɓi babban fayil ba
setupRestoreNone: Babu kwafin Leafen a wannan wuri.
setupRestoreSealed: Akwai kwafin da aka rufe da sirri. Shigar da kalmar sirrin kwafi ko lambar dawo da ita don buɗe su.
setupRestoreSecret: Kalmar sirrin kwafi ko lambar dawo da ita
setupRestoreRestarting: Sabar tana sake farawa a kan abin da aka dawo da shi. Idan ta dawo, wannan burauza za ta shiga a matsayin asusun mai sabar.
setupRestoreRestartingApp: Sabar tana sake farawa da abin da aka maido da shi. Da zarar ta dawo, wannan manhaja za ta shiga a matsayin asusun mai sabar.
setupRestoreManual: Sabar za ta buɗe a kan abin da aka dawo da shi lokacin da ta sake farawa. Rufe sabar ko manhajar sannan a sake buɗe ta. Idan ta dawo, wannan burauza za ta shiga a matsayin asusun mai sabar.
setupRestoreManualApp: Sabar za ta buɗe da abin da aka maido da shi a lokacin da za ta sake farawa. Rufe manhajar kuma sake buɗe ta. Da zarar ta dawo, wannan manhaja za ta shiga a matsayin asusun mai sabar.
setupRestoreClosed: An riga an saita wannan uwar garke. Shiga.
setupRestoreFolderUnreadable: Ba a iya karanta wannan babban fayil ɗin ba. Duba cikakkiyar hanyarsa.
setupRestoreFolderUnreadableContainer: An kasa karanta wannan babban fayil. Wannan uwar garke tana aiki a cikin kwantena, don haka ba za ta iya karanta wata hanyar wannan kwamfuta ba. Saka hanyar da ke cikin {{folder}}, wurin da aka ɗora don kwafin ajiya.
setupRestoreFolderUnreadableDevice: Ba a iya karanta wannan babban fayil ɗin ba. Sake zaɓe shi.
setupRestorePlaceUnreadable: An kasa karanta wannan wurin. Duba adireshinsa ko hanyarsa da bayanan shiga.
setupRestorePlaceInvalid: Faɗi sunan wurin da kwafin suke. Don babban fayil, rubuta cikakken hanyarsa.
setupRestoreUnavailable: Ba a iya buɗe wancan kwafin ba ko kuma bai ƙunshi abin da jerinsa ya ce ba.
setupRestoreEarlierLeafen: Wannan kwafin ajiya na wani Leafen ne na baya, wanda wannan sigar ba ta buɗe shi. Fara sabo a nan maimakon haka, sannan ka matsa wuraren aikinsa ɗaya bayan ɗaya: ƙirƙiri sabon wurin aiki a nan ka fara shi da “Matsa daga wata uwar garke”, sannan ka liƙa lambarsa a cikin saitunan wurin aiki na Leafen ɗin baya, ƙarƙashin Matsa wannan wurin aiki.
setupRestoreNewerLeafen: Wannan kwafin ajiya na wani Leafen ne wanda ya fi wannan sabo. Shigar da wannan sigar ko wata ta gaba, sannan ka mayar da shi.
setupRestoreAgentOpenNote: Wakili yana nemo kwafin ajiya ya mayar da su. Kai kana saka kalmomin sirri da makullai a nan da kanka.
setupRestoreAgentWhereBody: Wannan ne ke ƙayyade yadda wakilinka zai isa wannan uwar garke.
setupRestoreAgentHereNote: Wakili da ke gudana a wannan kwamfuta, kamar Claude Code ko Codex. Babu abin da ke buɗewa zuwa waje.
setupRestoreAgentElsewhereNote: Wakili a intanet, kamar Claude ko ChatGPT a cikin manhaja ko a yanar gizo. Ana buɗe shiga daga waje don mayar da bayanai kawai.
setupRestoreAgentOutsideTitle: Da farko, buɗe hanyar shiga daga waje
setupRestoreAgentOutsideBody: Don wakilin ku da ke wani wuri ya isa wannan sabar, ana buɗe shi don mayar da bayanai kawai. Babu abin da ke wucewa ta cikinsa sai mayar da bayanai, kuma yana rufewa da zarar an gama mayar da bayanai ko kuka daina.
setupRestoreAgentQuick: Buɗe hanyar haɗi ta sau ɗaya
setupRestoreAgentQuickNote: Yana buɗewa nan take ba tare da asusu ba, ta hanyar Cloudflare.
setupRestoreAgentTailscaleNote: Shiga da asusun Tailscale na kyauta. Na'urar da aka yi don wannan maido da ita za ta ɓace idan an gama.
setupRestoreAgentOutsideFailed: An kasa buɗe shiga daga waje. Ana sake gwadawa…
setupRestoreAgentOutsideFailedQuick: Wannan hanyar sadarwa na iya toshe hanyar haɗi. Tsaya, sannan buɗe hanyar shiga da Tailscale, ko bar wakili a wannan kwamfuta ya dawo da ita maimakon haka.
setupRestoreAgentOutsideFailedTailscale: Tailscale ya kasa buɗe adireshin. Tsaya, sannan buɗe hanyar haɗi ta sau ɗaya, ko bar wakili a wannan kwamfuta ya dawo da ita maimakon haka.
setupRestoreAgentTailscaleAllow: Ku ba da izinin adireshin jama'a a Tailscale.
setupRestoreAgentPublishing: Tailscale yana gaya wa intanet adireshin Leafen. A karon farko yana iya ɗaukar mintuna kaɗan.
setupRestoreAgentSentenceBody: Wakilin ku yana samun kwafin ajiya kuma yana mayar da su. Ku rubuta kalmomin sirri da maɓallai da kanku a nan, cikin filayen da ya nuna muku.
setupRestoreAgentCodeNote: Lambar da ke ciki tana aiki don wannan mayar da bayanai kawai, kuma tana tsayawa da zarar an gama mayar da bayanai ko cikin mintuna {{minutes}}.
setupRestoreAgentRestoring: Wakilin ku yana mayar da bayanai…
setupRestoreAgentFoundReplica: Akwai kwafin da ke ci gaba.
setupRestoreAgentSecretsTitle: Rubuta waɗannan a nan da kanka
setupRestoreAgentSecretsNote: Wakilin ku ba ya ganin su; wannan sabar tana amfani da su don wannan mayar da bayanai kawai.
setupRestoreAgentPromptIntro: Taimaka mini in dawo da tsohon Leafen na daga kwafin ajiyarsa. Wani sabon uwar garken Leafen, wanda ba shi da mai gudanarwa tukuna, yana jiran a cika shi da su.
setupRestoreAgentPromptTalk: Yi magana da ni da Hausa.
setupRestoreAgentPromptMcp: Uwar garken MCP na maido da Leafen (Streamable HTTP, babu shiga): {{address}}
setupRestoreAgentPromptCode: Lambar maido da sau ɗaya: {{code}} — a ba da ita a matsayin restore_code ga kowane kayan aiki. Tana aiki don wannan maido da kawai, kuma tana tsayawa da zarar an gama maido da ko cikin mintuna {{minutes}}. Kada a adana ta a cikin fayiloli ko a ba wa kowa.
setupRestoreAgentPromptApi: Idan ba za ka iya amfani da uwar garken MCP nan da nan ba, yi wannan ta hanyar JSON API: aika JSON {"restoreCode": "<code>", …} zuwa {{address}}/status, /find da /run.
setupRestoreAgentPromptChatApps: Idan ba a iya ƙara uwar garken MCP ba (Claude.ai, ChatGPT da sauran manhajojin hira), gaya mini in ƙara haɗin kai na musamman marar tabbatarwa a adireshin da ke sama — a Claude, Customize → Connectors → Add → Add custom connector; a ChatGPT, Plugins → + → Add custom MCP server.
setupRestoreAgentPromptClaudePort: Amma wannan adireshi yana amfani da port {{port}}, kuma masu haɗin Claude na musamman suna haɗawa ne kawai da adireshin https marar port (443), don haka mai haɗin Claude ba zai iya haɗawa da shi ba. Idan kai Claude ne a cikin hira kuma za ka haɗa ta mai haɗi, gaya mini haka kawai: mai haɗin ne kawai ba ya aiki, kuma burauza, manhajoji da wakilai irin su Claude Code suna haɗawa da wannan adireshi yadda yake. Don mai haɗi, ina bukatar Tailscale na Leafen (adireshin jama'a kyauta), tunnel ɗin Cloudflare na kaina, ko adireshin da aka buɗe a kan port 443.
setupRestoreAgentPromptSteps: Fara da leafen_restore_status sannan bi shi: tambaye ni inda tsohon Leafen na ya ajiye kwafin sa (babban fayil, WebDAV ko ma'ajiya mai jituwa da S3), nemo shi da leafen_restore_find, maido da abin da na zaɓa da leafen_restore_run, sannan duba har zuwa ƙarshe.
setupRestoreAgentPromptSecrets: Kada a tambaye ni kalmomin sirri, lambobin dawo da asali ko maɓallan ajiya a cikin tattaunawarmu: gaya mini wane fili a allon saitin Leafen zan cika, ni kuma zan rubuta su a can da kaina.

away.title: Ba a iya tuntuɓar sabar
away.body: Duba cewa uwar garken tana kunne kuma wannan na'urar tana kan hanyar sadarwar da za ta isa gare ta. Za a ci gaba da shiga da kanta idan uwar garken ta amsa.

updating.title: Ana sabunta Leafen
updating.body: Za a ci gaba da shiga da kanta idan an gama sabuntawa.

updateFailed.title: Leafen bai iya kammala sabuntawa ba
updateFailed.body: Sanar da mai gudanar da wannan uwar garke. Zai iya ganin dalilin a rikodin uwar garke.

slow.title: Sabar tana jinkirin amsawa
slow.body: Za a ci gaba da shiga da kanta idan ta amsa.
